answer_2.quote: we incorporate objective automatic metrics to assess sample quality, including Multi-resolution STFT (M-STFT) loss, Perceptual Evaluation of Speech Quality (PESQ), Mel-cepstral distortion (MCD) with dynamic time warping, Periodicity error, and the F1 score for voiced/unvoiced (V/UV) classification.

answer_4.quote: we conduct a 5-point Similarity Mean Opinion Score (SMOS) test as described in BigVGAN. This subjective evaluation is carried out by ten volunteers, and the reported SMOS scores include a 95% confidence interval. 150 audio samples are generated per dataset for testing, with six different workers rating each sample.
answer_4.guideline: 5-point Similarity Mean Opinion Score (SMOS) test, rating audio similarity/quality.
